steps.name: Wolf's Call
steps.objective: After meeting the special young man in "Elias", go to the Elias palace guard room.

lines.text: Proceed with the story.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (It seems like the weather in Elias is sunny today.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (A warm wind warmed by the sunlight blows...)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (A young man on the roof of a house in Elias is looking down at the ground.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (It looks somewhat familiar...)

lines.speaker: 청년
lines.text: Um… ?

lines.speaker: 청년
lines.text: You are the Adventurer the king spoke about.

lines.speaker: 청년
lines.text: Hehe...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (The young man raises one corner of his mouth and looks this way.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (The drowsy eyes are impressive.)

lines.speaker: 청년
lines.text: (Indeed... I understand why he cares.)

lines.speaker: 청년
lines.text: Hehe, you're cute.

lines.speaker: 청년
lines.text: My name is Jeryl. Remember that.

lines.speaker: 제릴
lines.text: I'm sorry for calling you here, but I can't move because of a prior appointment.

lines.speaker: 제릴
lines.text: You have a wizard's ring, right? Give it to me.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I handed Siam’s ring to Jeril.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (The ring glows blue in Jeril's hand and then returns to its original state...)

lines.speaker: 제릴
lines.text: Now... I've put the power into the ring, so I can just give it a new magic and use it.

lines.speaker: 제릴
lines.text: Not sure what the story is about? I was just asked to power the ring, Elias Go to the royal court and find out.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Jeril snaps his fingers and blue flames fly out.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (The power that feels like it belongs to Jeril... As that power approaches, I can feel it moving somewhere.)

lines.speaker: 제릴
lines.text: .........Did he go?

lines.speaker: 제릴
lines.text: He's a brave kid. Looks like something to look forward to.

lines.speaker: 제릴
lines.text: Stop hiding now and come out.

lines.speaker: 제릴
lines.text: ...What, did you change your hairstyle?

lines.speaker: 제릴
lines.text: Now, I’m saying goodbye to that hip-hop fashion that didn’t suit me.

lines.speaker: 제릴
lines.text: He looks like a jerk... What is that? What are you doing running around with so little energy left?

lines.speaker: 제릴
lines.text: You fought? With that kid just now? ...Hey, is that it? It wasn't like that when I was playing with my clones at the Colosseum.

lines.speaker: 제릴
lines.text: Anyway, if there's anything left you want to do, be careful. If it's 'restored' before then, it's a big deal, right?

lines.speaker: 제릴
lines.text: ...Like a gambler...

lines.speaker: 제릴
lines.text: What's good? I won't refuse any of your requests, but I will stick with you until the end.

lines.speaker: 제릴
lines.text: It doesn't matter where, I'll take you there.

lines.speaker: 제릴
lines.text: Let's go, to meet the peak of new light.
Proceed with the story.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (The branches are so intricately intertwined that it is impossible to tell where they sprouted from.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I tried to go in the direction of the stem, but my sense of direction became disorganized several times.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I decided to move with the tree trunk always in sight...)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (So far, nothing special has been discovered other than trees.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (What should I do if this condition continues until I reach the stem? Why not go up to the top and look down?)
No, I don't think you'll find anything special even if you look from up there.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Suddenly someone spoke to me!)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (It's a black-haired boy... I don't know if he came close to me before I knew it.)

lines.speaker: 소년
lines.text: Ah... I guess I surprised you. Sorry.

lines.speaker: 소년
lines.text: It's my first time talking to someone other than her, so I guess I made a mistake.

lines.speaker: 소년
lines.text: H-um...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (The boy looks this way, as if he is somehow intrigued.)

lines.speaker: 소년
lines.text: After all, I don’t know who it is!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (The boy seems happy for some reason...)

lines.speaker: 소년
lines.text: I know you're not a 'one who has opened your eyes'.

lines.speaker: 소년
lines.text: Are you perhaps from another world?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Nods his head...)

lines.speaker: 소년
lines.text: Yes, that's right...! As expected, the world was not one...!

lines.speaker: 소년
lines.text: It's an exciting story... Will I be able to visit another world someday...?

lines.speaker: 소년
lines.text: Oh, that's right. I forgot to introduce myself.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (The boy grins and then speaks in a somewhat solemn voice.)

lines.speaker: 소년
lines.text: Traveler from an unknown land. Welcome back. I am the guardian of this world that has not awakened yet... um... so...

lines.speaker: 소년
lines.text: ...When I try to be formal, it becomes awkward and annoying... Let's leave this aside. Are you okay?

lines.speaker: 소년
lines.text: I am Odin.

lines.speaker: 오딘
lines.text: You have no idea how happy I am to meet you like this.

lines.speaker: 오딘
lines.text: My world is still small and unattractive, but I welcome it. Won't you tell me the story of your world?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Meeted with Odin.)
Proceed with the story.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I found the girl.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (He is looking into space with somewhat sad eyes.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (The world tree around where she stepped feels like it has lost its vitality and faded...)

lines.speaker: 소녀
lines.text: Ah...

lines.speaker: 소녀
lines.text: Odin's subordinate?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Her dazed eyes shine sharply and glare at me.)

lines.speaker: 소녀
lines.text: ...Was there anyone who could have opened his eyes before the God of Thunder?

lines.speaker: 소녀
lines.text: It doesn't matter. The soul returns to flame, and the body returns to frost...

lines.speaker: 소녀
lines.text: ...I'm sorry... You can curse me.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Was the sparkle in her eyes an illusion?)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (In an instant, her shadow seemed to get longer, and then her appearance changed shape...!)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (The giant black dragon’s claws attack!)

steps.name: A pair of eagles bringing destruction
dance of dawn and dusk
steps.objective: Talk to Odin at "The Well of Urd".

lines.speaker: 니이
lines.text: Wait.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (The black dragon spreads its wings wide, covers the body, and returns to the form of a girl.)

lines.speaker: 니이
lines.text: You... are so strong. Not a servant of Odin. Right?

lines.speaker: 니이
lines.text: Also, I don't see any 'shadows' cast over you or any 'threads' that are tangled up in you.

lines.speaker: 니이
lines.text: Who on earth are you?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Somehow it's hard to answer...)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I was thinking about what to say, but first I said my name.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Nii looks shocked.)

lines.speaker: 니이
lines.text: ...I know that name.

lines.speaker: 니이
lines.text: You are the flint of Ragnarok in this small world.

lines.speaker: 니이
lines.text: ...by Adventurer from Iris.

lines.speaker: 니이
lines.text: I too am a being who lives to fulfill her will...

lines.speaker: 니이
lines.text: I'm not the one you have to fight with.

lines.speaker: 니이
lines.text: Your opponent is... this world itself. You must defeat Odin.

lines.speaker: 니이
lines.text: Please listen to me...

lines.speaker: 니이
lines.text: Odin...

lines.speaker: 오딘
lines.text: Nii.

lines.speaker: 오딘
lines.text: I went to Mimir's spring.

lines.speaker: 오딘
lines.text: Haha... I was surprised.

lines.speaker: 니이
lines.text: Odin...?

lines.speaker: 오딘
lines.text: All living things have one destiny.

lines.speaker: 오딘
lines.text: Fate is the framework and way of life chosen by consciousness.

lines.speaker: 오딘
lines.text: Although the forms may be different, there is no difference in the weight of fate between gods, humans, and wild flowers blooming in the field. We live, suffer, and die equally according to our fate.

lines.speaker: 오딘
lines.text: Nii thought so too, because he was the nightmare of the World Tree, the Black Dragon of Destruction. Even before the world began, I thought it was a bit hasty.

lines.speaker: 오딘
lines.text: ...But no. yes?

lines.speaker: 니이
lines.text: Odin... I...

lines.speaker: 오딘
lines.text: In this small world, only Nii fought according to his true mission.

lines.speaker: 오딘
lines.text: Right? The black dragon of 'Iris'.

lines.speaker: 오딘
lines.text: ...don't be funny!

lines.speaker: 오딘
lines.text: I am Odin, the King of Light who will establish Asgard, the kingdom of light, lead the gods, and become the teacher of humans!

lines.speaker: 오딘
lines.text: Whoever Iris is, I will not leave this world in the hands of a heartless 'mother'...!

lines.speaker: 오딘
lines.text: Nii... I'll give you the real fight you wanted.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Golden energy rises from Odin’s body.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (The atmosphere begins to vibrate and swirl...!)

lines.speaker: 오딘
lines.text: Now... Ragnarok is beginning!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (The battle with Odin begins!)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Odin places his spear in the ground and steps back.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Odin's expression, which was full of anger, has now changed to a blank expression...)

lines.speaker: 오딘
lines.text: Let's stop... anyway... it's just an outlet for anger.

lines.speaker: 니이
lines.text: Woe... solution?

lines.speaker: 오딘
lines.text: ...Nii, Nii is mistaken.

lines.speaker: 오딘
lines.text: Even if you eliminate me, this world will not disappear.

lines.speaker: 오딘
lines.text: For me too, there is no point in fighting these two people and winning.

lines.speaker: 오딘
lines.text: There is no way to prevent the two worlds from colliding.

lines.speaker: 니이
lines.text: That... run...

lines.speaker: 니이
lines.text: That can't be......

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Nii collapses on the spot.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Odin looks at Nii like that for a moment and then turns this way.)

lines.speaker: 오딘
lines.text: There is one thing this world needs to fully open its eyes.

lines.speaker: 오딘
lines.text: It is <time>. And time is my domain.

lines.speaker: 오딘
lines.text: I'll let the world sleep like this for a while.

lines.speaker: 오딘
lines.text: We may be able to prevent catastrophe for a while.

lines.speaker: 오딘
lines.text: In the meantime, I want you to find the person who created this world... Iris.

lines.speaker: 니이
lines.text: Iris... Mother of the world...?

lines.speaker: 오딘
lines.text: Nii, I don't know because I've never connected with her like you do, but I know she's not a 'mother' or anything.

lines.speaker: 오딘
lines.text: As you may already know, she is essentially an ordinary human being... a pitiful being who happens to be involved in the secrets of this universe.

lines.speaker: 오딘
lines.text: So, I don't think finding her will solve everything.

lines.speaker: 오딘
lines.text: But at best... I can test whether I can destroy her and turn all her dreams into something that never existed.

lines.speaker: 니이
lines.text: Kill her...?

lines.speaker: 오딘
lines.text: ...Anyway, Nana Nii is tied to this world, and the choice is yours.

lines.speaker: 오딘
lines.text: Well... you don't want to fall asleep with this world, do you? I'll send you to your world.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (When Odin raises his hand and points at me, the world around him disappears into a hazy fog...)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Odin's voice is heard from afar.)

lines.speaker: 오딘
lines.text: ...I thought we could be friends. I never thought it would be like this...

lines.speaker: 오딘
lines.text: I'm sorry for getting angry when it wasn't your fault. May good luck be with you...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Left Yggdrasil.)

lines.speaker: 오딘
lines.text: ...Hey, are you back?

lines.speaker: 오딘
lines.text: ...It's amazing, Nii. Ordinary humans travel between worlds and are involved in the fate of the universe.

lines.speaker: 오딘
lines.text: Would the humans of our world, which I was planning to create, also become beings with such rich potential?

lines.speaker: 오딘
lines.text: Haha... I definitely want to see it with my own eyes at least once...

lines.speaker: 니이
lines.text: Odin...

lines.speaker: 오딘
lines.text: Nii, what do you plan to do next?

lines.speaker: 니이
lines.text: huh...?

lines.speaker: 오딘
lines.text: On the off chance that it is possible, Yggdrasil... we could try burning the World Tree.

lines.speaker: 오딘
lines.text: This is possible if we forcibly open Surtur's territory and pour the river of fire flowing through Niflheim into Yggdrasil.

lines.speaker: 오딘
lines.text: If Nii wants that... I'll help.

lines.speaker: 니이
lines.text: Odin... that's...

lines.speaker: 니이
lines.text: No. If we do that, our world won't disappear.

lines.speaker: 니이
lines.text: It's just that this ruined world, ruled by death before it even begins, will collide with another world...

lines.speaker: 니이
lines.text: Actually, you think so too, right?

lines.speaker: 니이
lines.text: I... I don't know anymore.

lines.speaker: 니이
lines.text: Let me be by your side.

lines.speaker: 니이
lines.text: I want to be by your side... until the day the world ends.

lines.speaker: 오딘
lines.text: ...nii.

lines.speaker: 니이
lines.text: ...If we can't do anything and go nowhere, why on earth were we even born...

lines.speaker: 니이
lines.text: It's vain...is there no meaning...to our lives...?
Right... no.
The meaning... must be... there.

lines.speaker: 오딘
lines.text: This evil energy...?

lines.speaker: 오딘
lines.text: ...It's a day with a lot of customers. But I'm not very happy with the foul-smelling wild dogs.

lines.speaker: 제릴
lines.text: Haha... This puts the young god in a bad mood. Wild dogs are a bit too much, right? To such a pretty wolf.

lines.speaker: 제릴
lines.text: Please be patient, I didn't come here to fight.

lines.speaker: 니이
lines.text: ...and you?

lines.speaker: 제릴
lines.text: Hmm. This... it's really hard no matter how I am. Actually, does it make sense for Agashura to come to another world to play? This is so...

lines.speaker: 제릴
lines.text: If I don't return to the original world quickly, I will be 'restored' in an instant.

lines.speaker: 제릴
lines.text: Now... let's just talk about what we have to say and then go back. I can't guarantee how much I can protect you.

lines.speaker: 제릴
lines.text: Young gods. Please listen to this friend's story for a moment.

lines.speaker: 오딘
lines.text: story?

lines.speaker: 제릴
lines.text: story.

lines.speaker: 제릴
lines.text: This friend, who had bad gambling luck, risked everything...

lines.speaker: 제릴
lines.text: It's a story about hope.
